annotation.title_clean: Informe de Ponencia para primer debate del Proyecto de Ley No. 043 de 2025 Senado - 324 de 2025 Cámara "Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia para garantizar su desarrollo ético, responsable, competitivo e innovador, y se dictan otras disposiciones"
annotation.title_en: Committee Report for First Debate on Bill No. 043 of 2025 Senate - 324 of 2025 House "Regulating artificial intelligence in Colombia to ensure its ethical, responsible, competitive and innovative development, and enacting other provisions"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congreso de la República de Colombia, Comisión Sexta Constitucional Permanente (ponentes: Flórez Porras, P.H.; Montaño Arizala, G.L.)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: This is a favourable committee report for the first debate on Colombia's government-backed Bill 043/2025 Senate – 324/2025 House. The bill sets up a comprehensive AI regulatory framework. It covers ethical principles, risk categorisation, transparency and accountability, data standards, research incentives, AI education and labour transition. It also includes a modification table and the text proposed for debate.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to all public and private actors across the AI lifecycle that have a territorial link to Colombia or direct effects there
Sets up risk categorisation of AI systems, with transparency and accountability mechanisms
Ministry of Education to add AI content across non-engineering higher education programmes
Provisions on labour transition and promoting innovation in the AI era
AI systems already operating must adapt to the law; funding through international cooperation and public-private partnerships
